note: Independent direct summation of serialized checkpoint arrays using compensated reduction; no model diagnostic budget called. Profile centers and heights come from actual partition; names denote acceptance locations, not ground truth. Atmospheric lapse is diagnosed from parent and fine height; rain is latest-step instantaneous, not accumulated seasonal rainfall. Balanced checkpoints older than the final release bundle are excluded to avoid mixing old and new reruns.
